text: In 2023 3M agreed to pay $6 billion to settle lawsuits by US veterans and service members who say its Combat Arms earplugs, issued to troops from 2003 to 2015, damaged their hearing.

source.name: NPR (Jay Price, WUNC): 3M agrees to pay $6 billion to service members for faulty earplugs
source.quote: 3M has agreed to pay $6 billion to veterans and service members who say their hearing was damaged while they used faulty earplugs made by a 3M subsidiary.

additionalSources.name: Military.com (Rebecca Kheel): 250,000 Veterans Agree to $6 Billion Settlement with 3M over Earplugs Alleged to Cause Hearing Loss
